title: LoRaWAN WoT Binding Thing Metadata
description: Validation rules for the Thing-level LoRaWAN OTAA identity and onboarding terms within a Thing Description. Vendor and model are expressed with schema:brand / schema:model and the device revision with TD core's 'version' object, so this binding defines no terms of its own for them. Secrets (AppKey/NwkKey) must NOT appear here; they are declared as 'apikey' security schemes and injected at runtime.

lorav:region.description: Regulatory region / profile of the device, e.g. 'EU868', 'US915'.

lorav:frequencyPlan.description: LoRaWAN Network Server frequency plan identifier, e.g. 'EU_863_870_TTN'.

lorav:payloadLayout.description: Overall structure of the device payload.

lorav:tagFields.description: For 'tlv'/'ctv' layouts, the leading tag field(s) (e.g. channel + type) that select a value.

not.description: Root keys that must never appear: the OTAA root keys are secrets and belong in security schemes, 'lorav:endian' is per-value and belongs on a form, and 'properties' is the withdrawn pre-events shape (a LoRaWAN device pushes uplinks and cannot be polled, so its values are events).
